problem_statement: Convert excessive nested-token recursion into the library SQLParseError while preserving ordinary SELECT statements and bracket-quoted identifiers.
notes: The reference patch is the upstream implementation change under BSD-3-Clause in LICENSE.upstream.
The original MIT-licensed evaluation oracle temporarily lowers the recursion limit and parses 300 bracket pairs, restoring the prior limit in finally.
Only tests/test_parse.py and the external oracle are selected; the bounded reproducer is not an exhaustive SQL grammar or general CPU/memory bound.
